title: Min/Max Selector
statement: Create a combinational min/max selector that chooses either the smaller or larger of two 8-bit signed inputs based on a control input. When sel is 0, output the minimum; when sel is 1, output the maximum. The module should handle two’s complement operands correctly and produce valid signed results.
module_signature: module min_max_selector(input signed [7:0] a, input signed [7:0] b, input sel, output signed [7:0] y);
behavior: When sel is 0, y equals the smaller signed operand.
When sel is 1, y equals the larger signed operand.
Equal operands may output either value.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use sequential logic or registers.
hint: Compare operands as signed numbers, not unsigned.
